[[File:Code of a Hero menu.jpg|thumb|220x220px]]
'''Code of a Hero''' was a Spotlight Mission featuring [[Dinobot]] that ran from November 2nd to November 30th, at 5 am PDT.

It was ReForged for the month of June, running until July 4.

== Transcript ==
[[Code of a Hero/Transcript]]

== Rewards ==

== Chapter 1: Golden Power ==

=== An Ally No More ===
* Boss: G1''' Shockwave'''

=== Golden Race ===
* Boss: G1  '''Galvatron'''

== Chapter 2: Dino Hunt ==

=== Dinobots and Confused ===
* Boss: G1  '''Grimlock'''

=== Destiny Deja-Yu ===
* Boss:''' Rhinox'''

== Chapter 3: Go For Gold ==

=== Hizzz Disk ===
* Boss: '''Waspinator'''

=== The Golden Code ===
* Boss: '''Dinobot'''
